title: Planning Constraint Calculator
description: Automated planning constraints analysis tool for UK residential projects.
content: The Planning Constraint Calculator was developed to remove the need for manual site analysis during early feasibility stages.
By aggregating publicly available planning data and applying rule-based logic, the tool enables rapid assessment of development constraints.
This significantly reduces the time required to determine site viability, allowing faster decision-making and improved project efficiency.
The system reflects a broader approach of integrating data and automation into traditional architectural workflows.
